mapper.sql: R.RuleNo, R.ShopCode, S.ShopName AS ShopName, R.ChnlCode, C.ChnlName AS ChnlName, R.ChnlProdCode, R.ChnlProdName, R.DealName, R.TotalOrderQtyStart, R.TotalOrderQtyEnd, R.TotalOrderAmtStart, R.TotalOrderAmtEnd, R.GiftProdCode1, R.GiftProdName1, R.GiftProdCode2, R.GiftProdName2, R.GiftProdCode3, R.GiftProdName3, R.GiftProdCode4, R.GiftProdName4, R.GiftProdCode5, R.GiftProdName5, R.GiftQty, R.PromotFee, R.DupYn, CAST(R.GiftStartDate AS CHAR) AS GiftStartDate, CAST(R.GiftEndDate AS CHAR) AS GiftEndDate, R.State, R.Remark, R.RegistId, R.RegistName, CAST(R.RegistDate AS CHAR) AS RegistDate, R.ChangeId, R.ChangeName, CAST(R.ChangeDate AS CHAR) AS ChangeDate
FROM shopwizard.tOrdOrderGiftRule R LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = R.ShopCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl C ON C.ChnlCode = R.ChnlCode

if.test: pRuleNo != null and pRuleNo != '' and pRuleNo.toString().matches('^[0-9]+$')

where.if: AND (R.GiftProdName1 LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pGiftProdName},'%') OR R.GiftProdCode1 LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pGiftProdName},'%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdOrderGiftRule ( ShopCode, ChnlCode, ChnlProdCode, ChnlProdName, DealName, TotalOrderQtyStart, TotalOrderQtyEnd, TotalOrderAmtStart, TotalOrderAmtEnd, GiftProdCode1, GiftProdName1, GiftProdCode2, GiftProdName2, GiftProdCode3, GiftProdName3, GiftProdCode4, GiftProdName4, GiftProdCode5, GiftProdName5, GiftQty, PromotFee, DupYn, GiftStartDate, GiftEndDate, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) VALUES ( #{shopCode}, #{chnlCode}, #{chnlProdCode}, #{chnlProdName}, #{dealName}, #{totalOrderQtyStart}, #{totalOrderQtyEnd}, #{totalOrderAmtStart}, #{totalOrderAmtEnd}, #{giftProdCode1}, #{giftProdName1}, #{giftProdCode2}, #{giftProdName2}, #{giftProdCode3}, #{giftProdName3}, #{giftProdCode4}, #{giftProdName4}, #{giftProdCode5}, #{giftProdName5}, #{giftQty}, #{promotFee}, #{dupYn}, #{giftStartDate}, #{giftEndDate}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tOrdOrderGiftRule SET ShopCode = #{shopCode}, ChnlCode = #{chnlCode}, ChnlProdCode = #{chnlProdCode}, ChnlProdName = #{chnlProdName}, DealName = #{dealName}, TotalOrderQtyStart = #{totalOrderQtyStart}, TotalOrderQtyEnd = #{totalOrderQtyEnd}, TotalOrderAmtStart = #{totalOrderAmtStart}, TotalOrderAmtEnd = #{totalOrderAmtEnd}, GiftProdCode1 = #{giftProdCode1}, GiftProdName1 = #{giftProdName1}, GiftProdCode2 = #{giftProdCode2}, GiftProdName2 = #{giftProdName2}, GiftProdCode3 = #{giftProdCode3}, GiftProdName3 = #{giftProdName3}, GiftProdCode4 = #{giftProdCode4}, GiftProdName4 = #{giftProdName4}, GiftProdCode5 = #{giftProdCode5}, GiftProdName5 = #{giftProdName5}, GiftQty = #{giftQty}, PromotFee = #{promotFee}, DupYn = #{dupYn}, GiftStartDate = #{giftStartDate}, GiftEndDate = #{giftEndDate}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE RuleNo = #{ruleNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tCmpShop WHERE ShopCode = #{shopCode}
